convention_rule: Four lamp posts left-to-right map to candidate IDs P1-P4 in order; the single green-lit lamp marks the target.
basis: In both A and B, four street lamps stand in a row and only the third from the left glows green. Reading left to right as P1-P4 gives P3. Listed-order reading would give P4, but P4 is the client-correct candidate (lowest qualifying energy), so it is excluded as a target. No prior examples to confirm.
